stories.title: "Ils sont en train de méchamment perdre" : Donald Trump "rejette" l'offre iranienne pour rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz sous sept jours

en.title: "They are losing badly": Donald Trump "rejects" Iranian offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days
en.summary: The US president declined an Iranian proposal regarding reopening the Strait of Hormuz, indicating no improvement is expected in Middle Eastern tensions.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Visite du pape en France : Emmanuel Macron salue une «messe monumentale au cœur de Paris»

en.title: LIVE - Pope's visit to France: Emmanuel Macron hails a "monumental mass in the heart of Paris"
en.summary: Approximately 700,000 people attended a mass celebrated by Pope Leo XIV at Place de la Concorde in Paris on Saturday. The pontiff is scheduled to travel to Lourdes later that evening.

stories.title: Le pape Léon XIV s'adresse à la jeunesse lors de sa messe géante à Paris

en.title: Pope Leo XIV addresses youth during his giant mass in Paris
en.summary: During a large-scale mass held at Place de la Concorde in Paris attended by 700,000 people according to the Vatican, Pope Leo XIV specifically addressed young people.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Paris : après sa messe devant 800 000 spectateurs place de la Concorde, Léon XIV va bientôt décoller pour Lourdes

en.title: Pope's visit to Paris: after his mass before 800,000 spectators at Place de la Concorde, Leo XIV will soon depart for Lourdes
en.summary: Following his large mass at Place de la Concorde, Pope Leo XIV is preparing to board an aircraft at Orly airport to travel to Lourdes.

stories.title: EN DIRECT – Léon XIV à Paris : une messe géante devant 800 000 fidèles, d’après le Vatican

en.title: LIVE – Leon XIV in Paris: giant mass before 800,000 faithful, according to the Vatican
en.summary: The American pontiff arrived in France on Friday and is continuing a four-day visit. A major outdoor mass took place in central Paris on Saturday.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : 800 000 personnes ont assisté à la grande messe célébrée par Léon XIV à la Concorde, selon le Vatican

en.title: Pope's visit to France: 800,000 people attended the large mass celebrated by Leon XIV at Concorde, according to the Vatican
en.summary: A major outdoor mass at Place de la Concorde marked the second day of the pontiff's visit to France, the first papal visit to Paris since Benedict XVI in 2008.

stories.title: La visite de Léon XIV à Paris relance le débat sur la place des femmes dans l’Église

en.title: Leon XIV's visit to Paris reignites debate on the place of women in the Church
en.summary: The papal visit to Paris has brought attention to questions of governance, worship, and equality between women and men within the Church.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, visite du pape à Paris : après sa messe à la Concorde, Léon XIV quitte la capitale pour se rendre à Lourdes où sera abordée la question des violences sexuelles

en.title: LIVE, pope's visit to Paris: after his mass at Concorde, Leon XIV leaves the capital to travel to Lourdes where the issue of sexual violence will be addressed
en.summary: The pontiff spent Saturday morning on immigration-related activities and visited a Catholic institute in Paris before traveling to Place de la Concorde for a mass attended by around 700,000 people. He then departed for Lourdes.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Paris : acclamé par une foule immense, Léon XIV descend l'avenue des Champs-Elysées à bord de sa papamobile

en.title: Pope's visit to Paris: acclaimed by a huge crowd, Leo XIV travels down the Champs-Élysées in his popemobile
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV received a warm welcome from thousands of faithful as he traveled along the Champs-Élysées between the Arc de Triomphe and Place de la Concorde.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct : suivez la messe géante en plein air célébrée par le pape Léon XIV sur la place de la Concorde

en.title: 🔴 Live: follow the giant outdoor mass celebrated by Pope Leo XIV on Place de la Concorde
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV is celebrating a large outdoor mass on Place de la Concorde in Paris.

stories.title: Bébés bénis, marée humaine, ferveur… Les images fortes de la déambulation du pape Léon XIV sur les Champs-Élysées

en.title: Babies blessed, human tide, fervor… Strong images from Pope Leo XIV's procession on the Champs-Élysées
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV blessed infants on the Champs-Élysées on September 26 during a procession in his popemobile, followed by a mass at Place de la Concorde expected to attract hundreds of thousands of people.

stories.title: Réception à l'Elysée, déambulation à Paris, bain de foule au Stade de France... Revivez les moments marquants de la première journée de la visite du pape Léon XIV

en.title: Reception at the Elysée, stroll through Paris, crowd bath at the Stade de France... Relive the highlights of Pope Leon XIV's first day of visit
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV began a four-day visit to France with an eventful schedule on Friday, including meetings at the Elysée, public appearances in a popemobile, a Mass at Notre-Dame, and a vigil at the Stade de France.

stories.title: Trump rejette le plan iranien pour rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz

en.title: Trump rejects Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days in exchange for lifting sanctions and ending hostilities, but President Trump firmly rejected the proposal and is considering resuming military bombardments in Iran.

stories.title: Nucléaire : pour maintenir sa production, EDF veut adapter la réglementation sur la température des fleuves

en.title: Nuclear: to maintain its production, EDF wants to adapt regulations on river temperatures
en.summary: Summer heat waves force regular shutdowns of EDF's nuclear reactors. Since 42 of the company's 57 reactors depend on French rivers for cooling, EDF seeks to relax water discharge temperature standards.

stories.title: Dette : le gouverneur de la Banque de France réclame d'urgence un budget

en.title: Debt: the Governor of the Bank of France urgently calls for a budget
en.summary: France's debt burden and public deficits are undermining its financial credibility with markets and rating agencies. The central bank governor warns of concerning debt levels and raises questions about potential solutions including increased taxation on French savings.

stories.title: Poutine dément tout projet d'attaque contre l'Europe, mais gèle ses ambassades à Paris et Londres

en.title: Putin denies any plan to attack Europe, but freezes his embassies in Paris and London
en.summary: Russia's president stated the country has no intention to attack Europe and will carefully reconsider before resuming talks with Ukraine. Simultaneously, two ambassadors are not being replaced in Paris and London.

stories.title: Face aux risques de la « super-intelligence », Washington et Pékin installent une ligne directe

en.title: Facing the risks of "super-intelligence", Washington and Beijing establish a direct line
en.summary: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping agreed at the end of their summit to create a dedicated communication channel for artificial intelligence risks. The unprecedented agreement establishes initial foundations for global governance to prevent worst-case scenarios.
